title: Locating the Production Shift Point
description: A manufacturing assembly line traditionally ran at increasing speeds, but due to a recent reconfiguration, the line was rotated by shifting the beginning sequence to the end. You are given the historical output rates of the stations as a rotated sorted array of unique integers. Find the minimum output rate in this array efficiently.
constraints: All the integers in rates are unique.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum value in the array.

examples.explanation: The original sorted array was [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], rotated 3 times.
The original sorted array was [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7], rotated 4 times.
The array is sorted and rotated 4 times (no effective rotation change).
